ulasadda: [Ula+sadda] (pu) CL=7 The word - Ula. See - Ulati.
ulati: [Ula+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) Arrives or reaches. (2) Happens or arises. (3) Goes or walks. (4) Seeks and wanders around. (5) Causes to arise.
ullakolikaṇṇi: [Yādicchakanāma] (ti) CL=7 A Ullakolikaṇṇi place. See - Ullakolikaṇṇivāsaka.
ullakolikaṇṇivāsaka: [Ullakolikaṇṇi+vasa+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī- ullakolikaṇṇivāsikā] One who used to live in Ullakolikaṇṇi place or region.
ullapa: [U+lapa+a] (ti) CL=7 One who speaks. See - Satullapa.
ullapana:
[U+lapa+yu]  CL=7 (1) Bragging, speaking excessively, or exalting oneself beyond one"s actual qualities—boasting, exaggerating, or glorifying oneself. (Ti) (2) One who is inclined to boast or speak excessively about themselves, often exaggerating. (3) Causing or encouraging someone to speak or act boastfully, exaggerating beyond their actual qualities.
[Ullapana(ti) [u+lapa+ṇe+yu].
ullapanapaccaya: [Ullapana+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause of flattering or a cause that is flattering.
ullapanasabhāvasaṇṭhita: [Ullapanasabhāva+saṇṭhita] (ti) CL=7 One who has a flattering behavior.
ullapanta: [U+lapa+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is flattering or speaking highly.
ullapanti: [U+lapa+a+anti] (kri) CL=7 He deceives and flatters. See - Ullapati.
ullapanādhippāya: [Ullapana+adhippāya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Desiring to speak highly or flattering. (Ti) (2) One who wants to make a claim.
ullapanādhippāyavirahita: [Ullapanādhippāya+virahita] (ti) CL=7 One who doesn"t want to flatter.
ullapanākāra: [Ullapana+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of flattering. The state of affairs is flattering.
ullapati: [U+lapa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 He speaks. He speaks highly (of) or flatters. He speaks to out of life (that life is virtues. (means speaks flattering or lies so the morals or virtues are killed).
ullapiyamāna: [U+lapa+ya+māna] (ti) CL=7 One who is being flattered.
ullapāpemi: [U+lapa+ṇāpe+mi] (kā,kri) CL=7 (Someone) will cause speaking or flattering. See - Ullapāpeti.
ullaṅgana: [U+lagi+yu] (na) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 27.] Flying up. Jump high. See - Ullaṅganākāra.
ullaṅganākāra: [Ullaṅgana+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The manner of jumping high. The manner that (someone) will jump high.
ullaṅghamāna: [U+laghi+ṇaya+māna] (ti) CL=7 Rise up or come out or jump over.
ullaṅghanasamattha: [Ullaṅghanā+samattha] (ti) CL=7 Ability to raise up or jump over.
ullaṅghanta: [U+laghi+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is jumping over or transgression.
ullaṅghayitvā: [U+laghi+ṇaya+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having flown or jumped up.
ullaṅghenta: [U+laghi+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to emerge or appear or transgress.
ullaṅgheti: [U+laghi+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 He carries up. He lifts or holds up.
ullaṅghetukāma: [Ullaṅghetuṃ+kamu+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 One who wants to jump up.
ullaṅghetuṃ: [U+laghi+ṇe+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To jump over or fly up. See - Ullaṅghetukāma.
ullaṅghita: [U+laghi+ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be bound and hanged. Should be bound and tied.
ullaṅghitvā: [U+laghi+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having flown up or jumped over.
ullaṅghitvāna: [U+laghi+tvāna] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having flown or jumped up.
ullaṅghiya: [U+laghi+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 To jump over. To overcome.
ullaṅghāpeti: [U+laghi+ṇāpe+ti] (ti) CL=7 Causes to lift up. See - Ullaṅghati.
ullihanta: [U+liha+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is lick (with tongue).
ullikhana: [U+likha+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Combing (hair). (Ti) (2) A cause of combing (hair). (Ti) See - Ullikhanakoccha.
ullikhanakoccha: [Ullikhana+koccha] (pu,na) CL=7 A comb that is a cause of combing (hair, beard).
ullikhita: [U+likha+ta] (na) CL=7 (1) Scratching. (Ti) (2) Inside the mouth that should be scratched.
ullikhitahatthidantasadisavaṇṇa: [Ullikhitahatthidantasadisa+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The appearance that is like an elephant tusk that should be scratched.
ullikhāpeti: [U+likha+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Causes to comb (one"s hair) or have one"s hair dressed.
ullitta: [U+lipi+ta] (ti) CL=7 Plasters inside (someplace) that (someone) plasters (on someplace) at that he is facing upwards.
ullittakuṭi: [Ullittā+kuṭi] (thī) CL=7 Should be plastered (someplace) facing upwards. Should be plastered inside (with cement). A small dwelling place or monastery. See - Ullittakuṭisaṅkhyā.
ullittakuṭisaṅkhyā: [Ullittakuṭi+saṅkhyā] (thī) CL=7 The number of dwelling places or monasteries that should be plastered (with cement) inside.
ullittāvalitta: [Ullittā+avalittā] (ti) CL=7 Should be plastered (with cement) both inside and outside.
ullittāvalittacchadana: [Ullittāvalitta+chadana] (ti) CL=7 The roof that should plastered both (inside and outside) (with cement).  (Ullittakuṭi, Avalittakuṭi with roofs).
ullittāvalittakuṭi: [Ullittāvalitta+kuṭi] (thī) CL=7 A small dwelling place or monastery that should be plastered inside and outside (with cement).
ulliṅga: [U+lagi+a] (na) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.78. Dhātvattha. 330.] (1) Causes to know or reveals. (Ti) (2) Should be caused to know or revealed.
ulliṅgenta: [U+lagi+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to know (others).
ulliṅgenti: [U+lagi+ṇe+anti] (kā,kri) CL=7 They cause to know. See - Ullaṅgeti.
ulliṅgeti: [U+lagi+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 78. Dhātvattha. 330]. (1) Causes to know or reveals.
ulliṅgetvā: [U+lagi+ṇe+tvā] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 Having revealed or having caused to know.
ulliṅgita: [U+lagi+ta] (ti) CL=7 Revealed or caused to know.
ulloka: [U+luca(loka)+ṇa] (na) CL=7 [In Dhāna, it is Ulloca. See - Ulloca.] A place that is in the upper place, (somebody) looks up this place. The upper place or region. Canopied ceiling. Ceiling. Ulloka(na) [ava+luca(loka)+ṇa] (1) A flooring sheet. A rough cloth that is a flooring sheet or a rough cloth stretched over a bedstead. (Ti) (2) A state of affairs that is looking down (position). (Ti) (2) See - Ullokapaduma. Ulloka(pu) [u+loka] The world or plane of existence that should be opened and shown.
ullokaharaṇa: [Ulloka+haraṇa] (na) CL=7 A period of removing and cleaning the neck of an insect (such as a spider).
ullokapaduma: [Ulloka+paduma] (na) CL=7 A Paduma lotus that faces downwards that is like looking down (something).
ullokapasādana: [Ulloka+pasādana]  CL=7 The miraculous power that unveils inspiring confidence.
ullokayamāna: [U+loka+ṇaya+māna] (ti) CL=7 One who is looking up.
ullokayanta: [U+loka+ṇaya+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is looking up.
ullokenta: [U+loka+ṇe+anta]  CL=9 [In the feminine gender, there is ullokentī] One who is looking up.
ullokenti: [U+loka+ṇe+anti] (kri) CL=7 They look up. See - Ulloketi.
ullokesi: [U+loka+ṇe+ī] (kri) CL=7 He looked up. See - Ulloketi.
[U+loka+ṇe+iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I looked up. See - Ulloketi.
ullokesiṃ: [U+loka+ṇe+iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I looked up. See - Ulloketi.
ullokesuṃ: [U+loka+ṇe+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They looked up. See - Ulloketi.
ullokeyyātha: [U+loka+ṇe+eyyātha] (kri) CL=7 You (pl) should look up. See - Ulloketi.
ullokita: [U+loka+ta] (na) CL=7 (1) Looking up. (Ti) (2) One who is looking up. (3) Should be looked up.
ullola: [U+loḷa+ṇa.ula+ola] (pu) CL=7 [Ullolayatīti ullolo. Dhāna,ṭī.662.] A big wave.
ullolana: [U+loḷa+yu] (ti) CL=7 Caused to be agitation and unstable state in succession.
ullolenta: [U+loḷa+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to agitate. See - Ullolana.
ullumpanabhāva: [Ullumpana+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 The nature of taking out.
ullumpanasabhāvasaṇṭhita: [Ullumpanasabhāva+bhaṇṭhita] (ti) CL=7 Well established in the state of taking out and helping (others).
ullumpanasabhāvāvaṭṭhita: [Ullumpanasabhāva+avaṭṭhita] (ti) CL=7 Established in the state of taking out and helping (others).
ullumpati: [U+lupa(lumma] (kri) CL=7 [+a+ti. Nīti, dhā. 216. Sī,ṭī,saca,2.433.] Takes out or extracts. (Causes to leave from unwholesome deeds and establish wholesome deeds).
ulluḷita: [U+luḷi+ta] (ti) CL=7 Restless (state). With a yoke that is a restless or unstable state.
ullāgha: [U+lāgha+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 One who healed diseases and lack of diseases.
uluṅka: [Ula+uka] (pu) CL=7 [Vi, pi,dhāna. U+añca+ṇa.] (1) A ladle. (2) A dipper (to take water).
ulūka: [Uddhaṃ+kaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Uca+ṇuka. "uddhaṃ kaṇṇāyassa uddhaṃkaṇṇo"ti sampatte niruttinayena ulūko. Ucati samaveti koṭaranti vānipātanā. Dhāna, ṭī. 638. Ula+ṇūka. Ulati gavesatīti ulūko. Moga, 7.26.] An owl. A fish-owl. A brown- hawk owl.
ulūkaaṇḍa: [Ulūka+aṇḍa] (na) CL=7 An owl. A fish-owl. A brown- hawk owl.
ulūkapakkha: [Ulūka+pakkha] (pu,na) CL=7 An owl wing or feather. See - Ulūkapakkhika. Ulūkapakkha(ti) [ulūkapakkha+ṇa]  (A robe) that is weaving with owl feathers.
ulūkapakkhika: [Ulūkapakkha+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 (A robe) that is weaving with owl feathers.
ulūkasakuṇa: [Ulūka+sakuṇa] (pu) CL=7 An owl. A fish-owl. A brown- hawk owl. See - Ulūka.
ulūpī: [U+rūpa+ī] (pu) CL=7 [Vi, pi,dhāna.] Dolphin. (In Vi, pi,dhāna, it is a crocodile).
ullaṅghetu: [U+laghi+ṇe+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To jump over or fly up. See - Ullaṅghetukāma.
ullokesu: [U+loka+ṇe+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They looked up. See - Ulloketi.
